summary: FMC Corporation filed an 8-K regarding Amendment No. 6 to its existing credit agreement. The amendment modifies financial covenants (maximum leverage, minimum interest coverage) and introduces a maximum secured leverage ratio of 3.50x. Certain subsidiaries become guarantors, granting security interests in assets and pledging equity as collateral. Negative covenants on liens, fundamental changes, and indebtedness are updated, with new restrictions on asset transfers. This is a routine debt-refinancing event, not a special situation. No deal terms are applicable—watch for any future strategic actions enabled by the amended credit facility.
